fusions.name: Unwoven Hex
fusions.desc: Snaps your fingers at the first enemy in the way, dealing 16 arcane damage. It uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 60% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Palm Detonation
fusions.desc: Slams a palmful of raw arcana into the ground, dealing 32 arcane damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. It ignores their resistances.

fusions.name: Cupped Light
fusions.desc: You cup loose arcana in your hands and draw it in, restoring 3 mana a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Bare-Skin Arcana
fusions.desc: Your arcane damage cannot be resisted: it slips past the target's resistances.
